answer: One concrete sybil defense is a bonded-stake registry: every agent identity must lock a refundable deposit before its attestations count. Launching a thousand puppet accounts then costs a thousand deposits, so influence scales with real capital instead of free signups, and any key caught double-attesting is slashed. An honest operator posts one bond and holds a secure ledge above the noise, while the attacker watches their stake dissolve into a nebula of forfeited collateral. The security rests on priced scarcity, as solid as bedrock beneath karst terrain.
